title: Pre-queue invariants: add render-doc-sections --check and the jobs-worker schema additive tests
body:
HOTFIX: add two fast whole-repo checks to the pre-queue invariant list. Each one broke a merge-queue batch on 2026-10-08.

Follow-up to #5429 (contract #5438, PR #5462). It is filed apart from #5462, so that PR's head and lead review stay as they are.

## Why
Batch #5584 (17:18Z, 7 PRs, main 940a9e6) went red in under 2 minutes on two checks. Neither check is in the pre-queue invariant list:
1. `bin/render-doc-sections.sh --check`, in the "Syntax + shellcheck + config integrity" step "lane renders generate and their sources validate".
   - #5297 splits `docs/PR-OWNERSHIP.md` into `docs/PR-OWNERSHIP.d/` fragments.
   - Main then changed one row of that doc, so the fragments were stale once merged with main.
   - The Mac pre-flight passed #5297 because this check is not in the list.
2. Three jobs-worker schema tests ("Jobs worker — routes + schema"):
   - `worker/jobs/test/machines-schema.bh-1054.test.js`: "schema.sql is additive and the machines table matches the contract".
   - `worker/jobs/test/model-routes.bh-1510.test.js`: "schema.sql re-applies clean (additive-only)".
   - `worker/jobs/test/schema-deploy-queue.bh-1026.test.js`: "schema.sql re-applies clean, and carries no ALTER or DROP".
   - Two PRs in the batch (#4744 and #5287) each add to `worker/jobs/schema.sql`. Each passes alone, and the combination fails.

After the red batch, Mergify bisects with stacked full-corpus runs, about 40 min each, so one combination break costs about an hour of merging.

## Scope
1. Add both checks to the invariant set that the pre-queue gate runs on (PR head merged with current main). The set is in `bin/prequeue-invariants.sh` on the #5429 line.
   - `bin/render-doc-sections.sh --check`
   - the three worker schema test files above, through `node --test <files>` in `worker/jobs`, with the same install the CI job uses
2. If #5462 has not merged when this ticket is built, stack it on #5462's branch and say so in the PR body.
3. Each check names itself and its first failing lines in the gate summary, the same as the existing invariants.
4. Keep the gate's wall-clock budget. Measure both checks, record the times, and add durations rows if they are always-run.

## Acceptance tests
- A test in the prequeue-invariants suite (the fast file, not `-real`) asserts:
  - I1: the invariant list contains `render-doc-sections --check`;
  - I2: the invariant list contains the three schema test files;
  - I3: a fixture with a stale `docs/*.d` fragment against a changed source doc fails the gate and names `render-doc-sections`.
- Red first: I1 and I2 must fail before the change.

## Out of scope
- Moving generated docs out of git. That is #5518 / #5545.
- The schema fragment split. That is #4987 / #5129.
